title: Weights + tokenizer acquisition, caching, offline operation
description:
**Files:** per the decision task's answer (e.g. `src/store/assets.rs`; consumer docs — no CLI changes); `README.md` privacy FAQ; `src/spec/ch02_querying.rs`.

**Acceptance:** fetch-on-first-use with content digest and cache under ~/.botspy/models/ (or the decided location), download-once semantics, clean typed errors when offline, no telemetry. The README privacy claim is updated to state the one-time fetch honestly.

Gates: cargo fmt --all; cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings; RUSTDOCFLAGS="-D warnings" cargo doc --no-deps; cargo test and cargo test --test bdd. All existing suites stay green (features/01_structure, features/03_importers, features/04_examples, features/cli).
